Nothing like a good stick chew in the grass! I really like chewing on sticks. I think it helps my teeth.

Sometimes my parents clean my teeth with special doggy teeth cleaning pads but I’m not crazy about that. I prefer to just chew on sticks like the old days! 

I’ve never once had a problem with it. Sometimes I even eat a little bit of the stick but I never have problems with that either. 

I think I just have an iron clad stomach.

Anyways, chewing sticks is the best. Especially when I’m out on a walk with my humans laying in the grass! 

I hope you all get to chew on some sticks today!!

I’ve been making a lot of friends lately. It is kinda weird always being the big friend. I wonder if I’ll ever get a chance to have a friend bigger than me. If you’re bigger than me, leave a comment so we can be friends!
Today we have a bow beagle and a sleepy chin beagle.
I’m starting to think there’s a pattern here. I’m always lurking in the grass. Maybe I am more of an outside dog than I thought. I wish there were couches outside. Why isn’t that a thing???
